kpple01.title: Pluto to Aries: Over It by Friday
kpple01.caption:
Aries tried to speedrun a breakup with a stopwatch, and Pluto crashed through the ceiling about it.
A planet that takes 248 years to lap the Sun says take your time. Who's your friend who's "totally over it" by lunch?

kpple02.title: Pluto to Taurus: The Mug You Kept
kpple02.caption:
Keeping their mug because it's comfy is a very human thing to do.
Letting go isn't losing, it's making room. Keep one kind memory if you like, and let the rest go slowly, at your own pace.

kpple03.title: Pluto to Gemini: Seventeen Drafts of Closure
kpple03.caption:
Draft one was a paragraph. Draft four was a poem. Draft five was a four-minute voice note.
Pluto's verdict: closure is something you give yourself. How many drafts are you on?

kpple04.title: Pluto to Cancer: The Reread at 3 a.m.
kpple04.caption:
3 a.m., scrolled all the way back to their very first hi.
You can honour a memory without living in it. Archive the chat if deleting feels like too much, text a friend, and get some sleep.

kpple05.title: Pluto to Leo: The New Era Launch
kpple05.caption:
Breakup, then a countdown, confetti and era number four.
Pluto got reclassified as a dwarf planet and didn't throw a party. Leo is still negotiating for a small one. Which sign announces their eras?

kpple06.title: Pluto to Virgo: Forty-Six Rows of Blame
kpple06.caption:
A spreadsheet of everything you did wrong is not closure. It's a trial with no end.
You can learn from a breakup without blaming yourself for all of it. Pick one useful lesson, then be kind to you.

kpple07.title: Pluto to Libra: Keeping Everyone After
kpple07.caption:
Libra after a breakup: brunch with the ex, coffee with the ex's cousin, a walk with the ex's dog.
Pluto says some endings get to be endings. The dog stays, though. Are you still friends with your ex's friends?

kpple08.title: Pluto to Scorpio: The Grudge Vault
kpple08.caption:
Pluto opens Scorpio's grudge vault, one filed hurt at a time. Stay for what's inside.
Holding on doesn't punish them, it just keeps you up. You don't have to forgive it all today, you just have to open the door.

kpple09.title: Pluto to Sagittarius: The Feeling Packed Light
kpple09.caption:
Sagittarius booked three trips to outrun one feeling, then found it hiding in the backpack, waving.
Pluto's fix is one coffee with it. Which sign books a flight instead of feeling things?

kpple10.title: Pluto to Capricorn: The Plan With Their Name
kpple10.caption:
When the five-year plan still has their name in it, it can feel like you failed.
A plan changing isn't failure, it's a new draft. Keep your goals and let the shape change. Save this for the day you rewrite yours.

kpple11.title: Pluto to Aquarius: Totally Detached
kpple11.caption:
Aquarius is completely detached. The lamp flickering every time the ex comes up says otherwise.
One pixel tear, strictly for science. Tag the friend who says "feelings are just data."

kpple12.title: Pluto to Pisces: Let It Out
kpple12.caption:
If you keep saying sorry for crying about something that ended weeks ago, this one's for you.
Crying isn't weakness, it's how letting go works. Feel it, then let someone sit with you.
